description: This file defines a 'SearchBar' UI component using Lightning JS framework. It provides a faux input element with custom rendering, input handling, and search trigger functionality.

methods.name: _startCaretBlink
methods.description: Starts blinking the cursor caret by toggling visibility every 500ms.

methods.name: _stopCaretBlink
methods.description: Stops blinking the cursor caret and resets its visibility.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input value and invokes the onSearch callback with empty string.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the input value programmatically, used for hydration or pre-filling.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Triggers the onSearch callback with the current input value.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets the component as focused and initiates caret blinking.

methods.name: unfocus
methods.description: Removes focus from the component and stops caret blinking.
